scope: Database sort order of retrieves, server-side data grids and page data sources

native.toolchain: Linux MxBuild portable app and Mendix Runtime via script/oql_native_oracle

native_semantics: NULL sorts first in both ascending and descending order
the empty string is an ordinary, smallest string
strings compare without regard to case; equal keys fall through to the next sort key
fixed: NULL sorted last in ascending retrieves
booleans could not be sorted in microflow retrieves
server-side grids chained unstable sorts and placed NULL last when descending
TypeScript sort used locale numeric collation and placed NULL last when descending
limitations: case folding uses Ruby downcase and JavaScript toLowerCase; non-ASCII collation is not certified
the in-memory list Sort operation is not covered: the runtime ignores its sort keys (separate follow-up)
